tldr: For every supplied infinite Zipf covariate profile with fixed exponent \(\alpha>1\) and fixed overlap \(0<\epsilon<1/2\), the paper determines the common original-record minimax order of ATE RMSE and honest connected-interval expected length. For \(1<\alpha<2\) the exact rate is the explicit polynomial-logarithmic-stretched-log expression \(\varrho(n;\alpha,\epsilon)\), with overlap-dependent Fourier constant \(q_\epsilon\); for \(\alpha\ge2\) the sharp rate is \(n^{-1/2}\). A terminating finite occupancy-band estimator, honest interval, and lawful same-profile full-mark lower construction prove both sides for every \(n\ge2\).
